final: WITH rating_averages AS (SELECT rating, AVG(length) AS avg_length FROM film GROUP BY rating), baseline AS (SELECT AVG(avg_length) AS value FROM rating_averages), kept AS (SELECT r.rating, r.avg_length, b.value AS baseline FROM rating_averages r CROSS JOIN baseline b WHERE r.avg_length > b.value), kept_mean AS (SELECT AVG(avg_length) AS value FROM kept) SELECT AVG(k.avg_length) AS mean_length, AVG(k.avg_length - k.baseline) AS mean_above_baseline, AVG(k.avg_length - m.value) AS mean_above_kept_mean FROM kept k CROSS JOIN kept_mean m WHERE k.avg_length > m.value
